coverage: partial — 91 of 136 failure conditions transcribed in v3.1.0 Slice 0. Subsequent slices will fill in the remaining 45 leaf-level conditions as the validate pass implements each section. JSON layout is the single source of truth; src-tauri/src/pdf/loom/matterhorn.rs is generated from this file in Slice 1 of v3.1.0 Loom. Verdict assignments by the Slab team; will be reviewed by an accessibility consultant before v3.1.0 GA.

verdictGlossary.auto: Decidable from the PDF object model alone — the validate pass runs the check and emits PASS/FAIL without human review.
verdictGlossary.human: Requires human judgement (e.g. is this image decorative?) — surfaced in the Loom Review tab with the offending node highlighted.
verdictGlossary.outOfScope: Depends on Slab features not yet shipped (multimedia, advanced forms, complex signatures). Tracked for a later release.
